description:
A checkout link for one county. product 'list_pass' (County List Pass, $19 one-time, 30 days): that county's
        full surplus funds and tax sale lists with the CSV. product 'auction_pack' ($149 one-time, 30 days, title-covered
        counties with an upcoming sale: upcoming_auction_sales): the pass plus every property of the county's upcoming
        sales pre-checked with a title search (open mortgages, liens, lis pendens, tax, violations) and its full report
        PDF. `state`: two-letter code; `county`: county name. No sign-in: give the user `checkout_url`; Creem asks for
        their email; after paying, the browser returns to the county list unlocked, and the purchase stays on the
        account of that email (sign in at /account with a code). Refunds: https://heritagedeed.com/refund-policy.
name: buy_county_list_pass
